Wingman | AI-Powered Conversation Intelligence Platform (RAG + NLP) Aug 2026 - Sep 2026
GitHub: github.com/singhaasveer-lab/wingman_ai
Co-built an AI platform that reads chat screenshots with OCR and analyzes interaction signals such as warmth, reciprocity

GiftBro AI | Hybrid ML + Generative AI Gift Recommendation System Jul 2026 - Aug 2026
GitHub: github.com/singhaasveer-lab/giftbro-ai
Built a hybrid recommender that ranks real catalogue items before any generation happens: candidates are filtered and
scored with TF-IDF, cosine similarity and weighted scoring against the recipient's relationship, occasion, interests,
personality, budget and things to avoid.
Used the Gemini LLM as a personalization layer that explains why each gift fits, how to personalize and present it, and drafts
a message to include, so the AI never invents products.
Exposed the pipeline through a FastAPI backend with SQLite-based history and a Streamlit frontend.
Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity, FastAPI, Streamlit, SQLite, Gemini API
SmartQueue AI | Intelligent Queue Management & Analytics System 2026
GitHub: github.com/singhaasveer-lab/smartqueue-ai
Built a digital queue system with real-time token generation, live queue position and wait-time estimates, multi-counter staff
dispatch, priority handling and a public live queue display.
Added AI queue intelligence for congestion monitoring, bottleneck detection, queue clearance estimation and traffic surge
simulation, plus analytics dashboards with CSV and JSON export.
Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Context API, Lucide React
StudyForge AI | AI-Powered Study Platform for CS Students 2026
GitHub: github.com/akshita-sharda/STUDYFORGE-AI-
Co-built a full-stack study platform where students upload PDFs and get source-grounded answers through RAG, with
Gemini-generated flashcards and quizzes and a local RAG fallback that shows retrieved source text when no API key is set.

Built study modes (explain simply, hint, debug code, viva practice), a subject library, a revision tracker, a planner and saved
conversations, with student accounts using signed tokens and hashed passwords.
Built the FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, and wrote an automated test suite for the API, chat, study and planner
features.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, RAG, Gemini API, pytest
